speaker: A
text: Welcome to the show. Today we are talking about how to plan a small garden.

speaker: B
text: Thanks for having me. The first thing I would do is look at where the sun falls during the day.

speaker: A
text: That makes sense. How many hours of sun do tomatoes need?

speaker: B
text: About six to eight hours. Lettuce and spinach are happy with much less.

speaker: A
text: And what about the soil? Should we buy something special?

speaker: B
text: Mostly compost mixed with the soil you already have. Keep it simple at the start.
